professionalSummary.text: Accountable for the automation installation project at the Midlands parcel hub, including the project budget.
professionalSummary.witness: the former operations director confirmed in writing that the candidate was the accountable project manager for the sortation installation, held the project budget of 1.2 million pounds and approved each supplier payment.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed the equipment supplier against contract milestones and payment stages.
experienceHighlights.witness: Set the milestone plan with the sortation-equipment vendor and withheld the second stage payment until the induction-belt defects were fixed and retested, logging each milestone against the contract schedule.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Planned commissioning and operational handover with site operations.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Planned the commissioning sequence with the site operations manager, with two weekends of trial sorts on real parcel volumes before the system was handed to operations.

skills.text: Maintained the project risk register and reviewed it with the supplier and site safety staff.
skills.witness: Kept the project risk register and reviewed it every fortnight with the vendor's project engineer and the site health-and-safety adviser, closing each risk with a recorded action.
